## What

#14944's ruling (comment `5548762263`, director seat, maintainer 「同意」, 2026-09-05) has three parts. Q1 B (the PM loop reads `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh --status` before each dispatch and does not dispatch while depth ≥ 2) is the `domain:devx` seat's and is being executed under #14944 itself. **Q3 A is this card**: the dev waiting discipline becomes protocol text in the dev contract — quoting the ruling verbatim:

> **Q3 = A.** Dev waiting discipline becomes protocol text: acquire once with the full budget, stay blocked, ⛔ never poll-and-retry, always set `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT` so a timed-out place is resumed.

and its execution line:

> `domain:skills` seat: the waiting discipline paragraph in the dev contract (same governed path; may ride in the same PR).

No open `domain:skills` card carries this text yet (read 2026-09-06T08:31Z over the lane's open cards for `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT` / `waiting discipline` / `14944`: 0 hits; control: the lane listing itself returned cards).

## Executable criterion

The `os-dev` contract (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, governed surface — draft PR, `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, human merge) states the four-part discipline as a paragraph a dev can be held to: (1) acquire the verify lock once with the full budget; (2) stay blocked — ⛔ never poll-and-retry; (3) always set `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=<slot>` so a timed-out place is resumed under the same name; (4) spend a queue timeout on lock-free work, never on idling, and record exit 99 as NOT MEASURED. Provenance line pointing at #14944's ruling and the depth table (exit-99 1.0% / 22.6% / 36.1% / 55.6% at arrival depth 1/2/3/4). If the devx PR for Q1 B is open when this is picked up, the ruling allows this paragraph to ride in that same PR; otherwise a separate governed draft.

Refs #14944.
